target.title: fix(discord): gate guild metadata reads [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who configured Discord read allowlists could still have guild-level metadata read through Discord action tools when an arbitrary guild or channel ID was supplied.

AI-assisted change.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Discord guild metadata and thread-list read paths now use the same read-target authorization checks as message reads. Guild-wide metadata reads require the guild to be allowed without narrowing to a single channel, while channel-specific metadata reads continue to authorize the concrete channel target.

This keeps Discord admin/mutation permission checks unchanged and does not add config, storage, provider, or migration surfaces.

## User Impact

Operators can expect Discord metadata tools to respect the configured read allowlist consistently. Allowed channel reads and guild-wide reads with a wildcard channel allowlist continue to work; non-allowlisted guilds or channels are rejected before the Discord API read runs.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/actions/runtime.test.ts` passed: 1 file, 111 tests.
